description: This file implements functions to manage variables within the Slap Sco Gallery Object, including retrieving, setting, adding, deleting individual variables, and deleting all variables. It is part of the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) component, handling variable management for the gallery object, with functions interacting with atom tables and variable cloning.

methods.name: SLAP_VARIABLE * SlapScoGalGetVariable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Retrieves the variable associated with a given name from the gallery's atom table, clones it, and returns the cloned variable.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapScoGalSetVariable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Sets or updates a variable in the gallery; adds the variable if it does not exist, or updates the existing variable by cloning the provided variable. Also handles the joining or quitting of the gallery object as needed.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapScoGalAddVariable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Adds a new variable to the gallery with the specified name, cloning the provided variable, and joining it to the gallery.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapScoGalDelVariable(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Deletes a variable identified by name from the gallery, quitting it from the gallery list and freeing associated memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapScoGalDelAllVariables(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Deletes all variables from the gallery, freeing resources and clearing all atom entries.
